title: Watcher state file
description: Every watcher writes exactly one of these beside its log and pid file in the configured state_dir. It exists so `status` reports machine-readable facts rather than a human parsing a log tail, and so a dead watcher is distinguishable from one that was never started. A bare pid file cannot answer what the watcher was watching or with what threshold.

pid.description: 0 when state is off or ended.

context_threshold_percent.description: Required on any watcher that can raise a compaction: the threshold travels with the spec. Read from the watched workflow's agent spec via bin/workflow-spec.sh, never defaulted inside the watcher.
